project: Automatos AI Platform — PRD-156 Security & Tenancy Hardening (Remediation Chain Night 1, stacked on PRD-155)
description: Branch from ralph/prd-155-route-contract tip. Closes every confirmed cross-tenant and injection hole BEFORE the PRD-150 open-core split widens exposure. Constraints: PRD-09 — board SDK-key reads stay on the narrow scope-gated dependency, do NOT touch shared hybrid auth; all identity threading auth-provider-agnostic (PRD-150). BINDING: Q6 multimodal gets workspace-scoping only (freeze), Q15 mem0 token auth now, Q13 mock /api/v1/memory deleted. Full spec docs/PRDS/PRD-156-SECURITY-TENANCY-HARDENING.md. security-reviewer agent pass on the final diff is part of acceptance.

userStories.title: Workspace+team scoping on multimodal search; persist team_access; fix similarity SQL
userStories.description: All four multimodal tools (search_tables/search_images/search_formulas/search_multimodal, modules/rag/services/multimodal_knowledge_tools.py:65-401) query knowledge_items with NO workspace clause — cross-tenant leak exposed to every agent via unified_executor.py:108-111. Add mandatory workspace_id + team filtering via the shared filter helper. Persist the team_access form field that upload silently drops (api/knowledge_multimodal.py:258). Fix the broken similarity subquery (WHERE content = :query exact-match → embed the query text properly so ranking is real).
acceptanceCriteria: Tenancy matrix test: workspace B items never returned to workspace A across all four tools
Uploaded team_access persists and filters retrieval (test)
Novel-query similarity returns ranked results, no NULL ordering (test)

userStories.title: Token auth on the OpenMemory (mem0) server
userStories.description: The mem0 server has ZERO auth — any process with network reach can read/write/delete every workspace's memories by guessing user_id strings; the orchestrator already sends Authorization: Token MEM0_API_KEY (mem0_client.py:160) which is ignored. Add one FastAPI auth dependency in the automatos-mem0 fork (sibling repo) validating the token on every router, key from env, provider-agnostic. Orchestrator unchanged. Document the Railway env var in the PR (chain rule: env BEFORE deploy).
acceptanceCriteria: Fork tests: missing/wrong token → 401, correct token → 200, all routers
Orchestrator integration suite green against the patched server
Railway env documented in PR description

userStories.title: NL2SQL tenancy: scope queries/audit/analytics; disable unsafe paths
userStories.description: Thread workspace scoping through NL2SQL query, audit, and analytics endpoints. DISABLE (do not shim) the query_main_database fallback and the unauthenticated HTTP self-call — the proper in-process path is PRD-160; until then the unsafe path is OFF. Remove NL2SQL from intent-classifier suggested_tools (smart_tool_router.py:80-84, intent_classifier.py:275) so it is unreachable from chat until PRD-160 re-enables it scoped.
acceptanceCriteria: Cross-workspace NL2SQL matrix test fails closed
Grep gate: query_main_database unreachable from any chat tool surface

userStories.title: Template IDOR + Jinja2 sandbox + WeasyPrint fetch allowlist
userStories.description: Template CRUD has confirmed cross-workspace IDOR — add workspace ownership checks on every read/update/delete. Rendering moves to Jinja2 SandboxedEnvironment (SSTI confirmed exploitable). WeasyPrint gets a url_fetcher allowlist: no file://, no link-local/internal-network fetches from user templates.
acceptanceCriteria: IDOR tests: workspace B cannot read/update/delete A's template
url_fetcher refuses file:// and internal IPs (test)
Existing template tests updated for sandbox; cd orchestrator && pytest -q green

userStories.title: Remaining closures: widget-memory ownership, content-path auth, scoped analytics, delete mock memory router
userStories.description: (1) widget_memory.py:277-280 deletes any memory id with no ownership check — mirror the correct pattern from memory_stats.py:462-470. (2) GET /api/documents/content (path-read, api/documents.py:411-452) has no auth dependency — add RequestContext. (3) RAG analytics (modules/rag/service.py:1007-1168) and document_usage writes (api/documents.py:1080,1362) query/write across ALL workspaces — scope them.
